post.description:
Bulk-create keyword assets and immediately submit them for configuration.
Valid assets are created and submitted in a single job — once processed they appear as active assets, not as pending candidates.
Invalid rows are skipped and returned in the response errors list.
Assets rejected during the submission process will appear in the Assets Creation tab with according status code.
Returns 207 when any row failed validation, 422 when all rows failed, 200 when all succeeded.

If any assets were successfully submitted, the response includes a `job_id`. Use the `GET /jobs/{job_id}` endpoint to poll the processing status of your submitted assets.

207.description: Partial success: valid rows were created and submitted; failed rows are listed in errors

get.description: Returns the status of an asset submission job initiated by a bulk-create request. While processing, status is 'in_progress' with no failed_items. Once terminal, status is one of 'success', 'partial_success', or 'failed', and failed_items contains details about candidates that did not succeed.

tags.name: Introduction
tags.description: The Assets API enables security teams to programmatically retrieve asset data from the Argos platform, allowing for inventory comparison and enhanced security decision-making. It supports filtering, pagination, and detailed metadata to streamline asset management.

tags.name: Rate limit
tags.description:
All external APIs are subject to rate limiting. The rate limits are as follows: 

 * 60 requests per minute 

 * 1,000 requests per hour 

 * 5,000 requests per day
